task.title: Preview as different readers
task.shortdesc: Serve the docs on your machine, rebuilding on save, and see exactly what each kind of reader gets.

context.p: The previewer uses the same build, filter and renderer as hosted delivery. "Preview as" is the real reader filter, not an approximation, so if a paragraph shows for a reader here, it shows for that reader in production.

step.cmd: Start the previewer on your docs folder.

stepresult.p: It prints any problems, then Serving http://127.0.0.1:4000/ (watching for changes). Open that address. Pages reload when you save a file.

info.p: With no reader options the previewer shows everything that survives the build-time filter, and marks each conditional element with its attributes, such as product=embed. Every alternative of a conditional key is shown, separated by a bar. Readers never see these markers.

step.cmd: Switch reader with Preview as in the banner at the top of each page.

info.p: The list holds the readers in preview-contexts.yaml. The choice is kept in a cookie, so it sticks while you browse. The banner also shows the reader's products, features and version, and a summary of any validation problems.

step.cmd: Or start the previewer as a particular reader.

choices.choice: --as admin picks a named reader from preview-contexts.yaml.
--product core,embed --feature early-access --version 0.1 describes a reader on the command line. --version defaults to the project's release.
--all is the staff view, the default.

step.cmd: Optional: preview a release branch or tag without checking it out.

info.p: A git ref is read once and not watched.

result.p: Besides the pages, the previewer serves a few helper pages:

dlentry.dd: Every PDF publication, and whether the current reader can see anything in it.
A publication printed for the current reader, and its print HTML.
What every context-sensitive help key and route resolves to. See .
The current validation problems as JSON.
